en: 2 Corinthians 6

p.src: 1  Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

en: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.
u.src: 1  Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

p.src: 2  For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

en: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.
u.src: 2  For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

en: 6:2 Isaiah 49:8

p.src: 3  We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

en: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,
u.src: 3  We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

p.src: 4  but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

en: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,
u.src: 4  but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

p.src: 5  in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

en: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,
u.src: 5  in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

p.src: 6  in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

en: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,
u.src: 6  in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

p.src: 7  in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

en: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
u.src: 7  in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

p.src: 8  by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

en: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,
u.src: 8  by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

p.src: 9  as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

en: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,
u.src: 9  as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

p.src: 10  as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

en: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.
u.src: 10  as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

p.src: 11  Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

en: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
u.src: 11  Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

p.src: 12  You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

en: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.
u.src: 12  You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

p.src: 13  Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

en: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.
u.src: 13  Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

p.src: 14  Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

en: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?
u.src: 14  Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

p.src: 15  What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

en: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?
u.src: 15  What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

p.src: 16  What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

en: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”
u.src: 16  What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

en: 6:16 Leviticus 26:12; Jeremiah 32:38; Ezekiel 37:27

p.src: 17  Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

en: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
u.src: 17  Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

en: 6:17 Isaiah 52:11; Ezekiel 20:34,41

p.src: 18  I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”
